# Part 3 final verification — simulated only

This is a deterministic software acceptance fixture, not an empirical benchmark.
Every citation, identifier, provider response, identity distinction, and provenance
timestamp is constructed for testing. `verified` provenance flags represent
simulated verification events required by the existing schemas; they do not claim
real-world verification. Do not merge this fixture into the pilot dataset.

`expected.json` contains hand-calculated expectations established before generating
or evaluating the lookup bundle. `config.json` explicitly labels all evaluation
results `simulated`. No live API requests are used.

Cases in source order:

1. `fixture-0`: correct candidate at rank 1.
2. `fixture-1`: confirmed incorrect candidates at ranks 1 and 2, correct at rank 3.
3. `fixture-2`: confirmed incorrect candidate at rank 1.
4. `fixture-3`: candidate with undetermined identity.
5. `fixture-4`: valid NOT_FOUND with no candidates.
6. `fixture-5`: API_ERROR generated by a mocked `httpx.ConnectError`.

The incorrect judgments require explicit simulated `different_work` mappings;
identifier inequality is not used to manufacture negative labels. Rank-three
candidate scores are deliberately nonmonotonic: 1, 99, 7.

Independent expected counts: T=6, N=5; H1=1, M1=3, U1=1; H5=2, M5=2, U5=1;
I1=2; empty=1; undetermined rank-one identity=1; API errors=1.

| Metric | Confirmed numerator / denominator | Uncertain count | Exact | Bounds |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Recall@1 | 1/5 | 1 | null | 0.20–0.40 |
| Recall@5 | 2/5 | 1 | null | 0.40–0.60 |
| Incorrect-match rate | 2/5 | 1 | null | 0.40–0.60 |
| Unresolved rate | 1/5 | 0 | 0.20 | 0.20–0.20 |
| Identity-undetermined rate | 1/5 | 0 | 0.20 | 0.20–0.20 |
| API-error / combined provider-error rate | 1/6 | 0 | 1/6 | 1/6–1/6 |

These bounds express missing identity evidence, not statistical uncertainty.

From the repository root with `.venv` activated:

```powershell
citeprobe evaluate tests/fixtures/part3-final-verification/lookups.json --dataset tests/fixtures/part3-final-verification/dataset.json --identity-mappings tests/fixtures/part3-final-verification/identity-mappings.json --config tests/fixtures/part3-final-verification/config.json --output verification.json
```

The command creates JSON and CSV. Use a new output filename for each run. The
acceptance test regenerates all input JSON byte-for-byte, runs the unchanged CLI
twice with client construction blocked, checks every case and metric field, and
compares both JSON and CSV output bytes. Outputs remain in pytest temporary storage.
